answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique oracle node response record. It works because responses signed by one node across thousands of rounds, and the shale it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Honest agents barely notice the check, because responses signed by one node across thousands of rounds is something they already have; the river falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ember for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
